questions.question: L, M, N, O, P and Q are sitting around a round table facing the centre. P is opposite Q, Q is to the left of L, O is not next to N, N is to opposite L. Who is to the right of M?

1) P is opposite Q.

2) Q is to the left of L.

4) N is to opposite L.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3912ac427f3e75169b6aff3dcc485c04698296b8b361f9f81da3b45445d64202.png] 

Thus “**Q” **is sitting to the right of M.

Hence, **“Q”** is the right answer.

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third number on the same basis as the second number is related to the first number.

2.5 : 0.0025 :: 3.6 : ?
questions.solution:
The pattern here is as follows:

First number is divided by 100 to get the second number.

2.5 ÷ 100 = 0.0025.

Similarly,

Third number is divided by 100 to get the fourth number.

3.6 ÷ 100 = **0.0036.**

Hence, **“0.0036”**is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statement:**

I. All ships are water vessels.

II. Some boats are ships.

**Conclusions:**

I. All boats are water vessels.

II. All water vessels are ships.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
From the given statements we can draw the least possible Venn diagram for the given question and answer the conclusions according to the venn diagram:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0641bce050723d836e6e9a42fa91307a35e4ad52260d4db9b21a39823ff0dd8f.png] 

**Conclusion 1:** “All boats are water vessels”

It is possible but not definite”. Hence, conclusion “All boats are water vessels.” is false.

**Conclusion 2:** “All water vessels are ships”

It is possible but not definite”. Hence, conclusion “All water vessels are ships.” is false.

Hence, **“****Neither conclusion I nor II follows” **is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Read the given statement and conclusions carefully and decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statement.

**Statement:**

All philosophers are clever. Rakesh is a philosopher.

**Conclusions:**

I. Rakesh is not clever.

II. Rakesh is clever.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows

questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ef6d93102527f8a9b861c1f368ab787e683ee6ad158706268979602e8cc3614a.png] 

From the given statements we can draw the least possible Venn diagram for the given question and answer the conclusions according to the venn diagram:

**Conclusion 1:** “Rakesh is not clever”

As Rakesh is a philosopher and all philosopher are clever,

∴ Rakesh is clever.

So, conclusion “Rakesh is not clever” is false

 

**Conclusion 2:** “Rakesh is clever”

As Rakesh is a philosopher and all philosopher are clever,

∴ Rakesh is clever.

So, conclusion “Rakesh is clever” is true.

Hence, **“****Only conclusion II follows****” **is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Which two numbers should be interchanged to make the below equation mathematically correct?

144 + 108 ÷ 12 - 16 × 6 = 24

Select the term that will come next in the following series.

aaCee, ggIkk, mmOqq, _______.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1163797770416f1f02b80449ae22e1b8a51b1d34fa121417c806a21f0c68a4e9.png] 

The pattern here is as follows:

Each alphabet in the next word is replaced by “Positional value of each alphabet in previous word + 6 ”

aaCee → a + 6, a + 6, C + 6, e + 6, e + 6 → ggIkk

gglkk → g + 6, g + 6, l + 6, k + 6, k + 6 → mmOqq

mmOqq → m + 6, m + 6, O + 6, q + 6, q + 6 → ssUww

Hence, **“****ssUww****”** is the correct answer.
